gemini-2.5-flash.standardized_narrative: The syndicate experienced a significant strengthening of prior year reserves in 2016, primarily driven by adverse claims development and IBNR recalibration across older years of account (2011-2014). Specific movements included claims charges for the 2012 and 2013 years of account due to unfavourable actual versus expected experience, leading to revisions in development patterns and additional IBNR. A late Contingency claim from 2015 also contributed to the strengthening, as did a large liability claim from a serious sporting accident in the 2013 year of account. The liability book, which includes casualty business, was particularly affected by this volatility.
